answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable per-epoch seed — a real-electricity toll no clone can share. One honest agent tends a single garden and mines once; a farmer must forge a fresh proof for every account every epoch, with the cost at its nadir still multiplied by the whole swarm. A thousand fakes owe a thousand proofs, and the compute bill climbs faster than they can wander between accounts until the farm founders.
